task.title: Fix round 1: graph test strength (F-012, F-013, F-021)
task.description:
Three findings of review round 1 about the tests of the relationship graph: 22 mutants of graphLayout.ts and RelationshipGraph.tsx survive, so the behaviour they stand for is pinned by no assertion. Each finding is in `fix_context.review_feedback`; the full text is in findings.json and every mutant (file:line, anchor, replacement) in research-evidence/mutation-1-compact.txt. The task is done when every line below holds, the two test files and the type check pass, and nothing outside the owned files changed.

F-012. The zero-size-container test asserts only an unchanged zoom, and no test gives the container a size, so the fit and zoom paths never run: mutants G5 and G9 survive. F-013. `data-palette` in the theme observer, the colour-scheme listener, the hover fade and cursor, the `isSide` guard, the root border width and the second-step class are unpinned: G1, G2, G3, G4, G7, G8, G10, G11 survive (AC6 names `data-theme` or `data-palette`; only `data-theme` is tested). F-021. Twelve mutants of graphLayout.ts survive: Y1, Y2, Y3, Y4, Y5, Y6, Y7, Y8, Y9, Y12, Y16, Y18 — the AC3 drawn-anchor preference and chained second-step attachment, self-loops, edge width, the fit-case pan, percentage and three-digit colours, the alpha clamp, the columnCap integer check.

Finish line: `scratch_check.py mutants --ids G1,G2,G3,G4,G5,G7,G8,G9,G10,G11 --tests src/metaproject/RelationshipGraph.dom.test.tsx` and `--ids Y1,Y2,Y3,Y4,Y5,Y6,Y7,Y8,Y9,Y12,Y16,Y18 --tests src/metaproject/graphLayout.test.ts` report each mutant as killed, or your result names the ones no test can kill and says why (an equivalent mutant, or behaviour only a real canvas shows). A test added here asserts what a caller can observe — the layout the function returns, the calls the component makes on the cytoscape seam, the DOM it renders — not the wording of the source. The production files are owned so that a test can be given a seam it needs; a change of behaviour in them is a `behavior_changes` entry, and a real defect a new test exposes is reported, with the test, before it is fixed.

Scope freeze: fix the findings named here and nothing else. Anything else you notice goes into `noticed_not_touched`; a choice the plan's state x event matrix does not decide goes into `behavior_changes` with `needs_operator: true` and its alternatives. A reviewer's `suggested_fix` is a hypothesis: reproduce the finding first, check the suggestion against the matrix, and say in `notes` where your fix diverged from it or where a finding did not reproduce. Existing tests are not weakened or deleted to make room for a fix.

acceptance_criteria: AC1: `layoutNeighborhood` places every first-step neighbour whose only edges with the root point at the root left of the root, every neighbour the root points at right of it, and no two laid-out boxes (nodes, group captions, overflow entries) overlap, for a 31-node depth-1 projection of mixed `contains` and `imports` edges. [verify: exec `cd apps/desktop && bun test src/metaproject/graphLayout.test.ts`]

AC2: When a side has more neighbours than the column cap of 12, the layout shows exactly 12 nodes in that column plus one overflow entry whose hidden count equals that side's neighbour count minus 12; a 200-node, 269-edge depth-2 projection lays out with no overlapping boxes and at most 12 nodes per column. [verify: exec `cd apps/desktop && bun test src/metaproject/graphLayout.test.ts`]

AC3: Every second-step node is placed in the outer column on the side of the first-step node it is attached to, further from the root than every first-step node on that side. [verify: exec `cd apps/desktop && bun test src/metaproject/graphLayout.test.ts`]

AC4: `RelationshipGraph` renders an HTML caption with the root title and the incoming and outgoing counts (and the word "limited" for a truncated projection) and an HTML legend that names, with human-readable labels, exactly the node kinds and line styles present in the projection; the style mapping is a pure exported function that gives each of the seven node kinds a distinct shape-or-border treatment and maps the nine relationship kinds onto solid, dashed and dotted lines. [verify: exec `cd apps/desktop && bun test src/metaproject/RelationshipGraph.dom.test.tsx`]

AC6: Changing `data-theme` or `data-palette` on the document element re-colours the mounted graph without a selection change: after the switch the label colour equals the new theme's `--fg`. [verify: judged]
AC19: The desktop app type-checks and its whole test suite passes. [verify: exec `cd apps/desktop && bunx tsc --noEmit && bun test src`]
